distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Debus amphicranoides from Yunnan, including Xishuangbanna. Smith et al. (2022) independently records Yunnan. This additional source supports the current reviewed distribution without changing it.

host_note: No confirmed host is promoted from either integrated Smith et al. record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Debus amphicranoides (Hagedorn, 1908).
